products.name: Monitaur
products.note: Model monitoring with built-in governance; unified monitoring + governance platform

profile_text.body:
Monitaur is a software company focused on AI governance, describing itself as providing "actionable governance for the entire lifecycle of your AI." Its platform is designed to help enterprises establish standards and controls across AI systems, with a stated emphasis on the insurance and financial services sectors. Use cases highlighted on its site include unifying policies across underwriting, claims, and risk models, governing third-party AI vendors, and validating models with consistent protocols and transparent reporting for internal teams and external auditors.

The company's core product, also called Monitaur, is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform that combines model monitoring with built-in governance. The site describes capabilities including continuous performance monitoring, model validation at scale, and integration with existing third-party risk management workflows. Monitaur notes a placement in Gartner's inaugural Magic Quadrant for AI Governance as a Visionary, and its site references customer case studies involving a leading insurance provider, an enterprise insurer managing third-party AI projects, and a Fortune 200 financial services company.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for this company.
